Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines hashcode(); should it be hashCode()? (NM_LCASE_HASHCODE)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method called hashcode().  This method
does not override the hashCode() method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. hashcode() hashCode() java.lang.Object
Bug_Explanation: The class defines a method called hashcode() instead of hashCode(). This causes a mistake because hashcode() does not override the hashCode() method in java.lang.Object.
Trigger_Explanation: The assertNotEquals function is used to compare the hashcodes of two objects. Since the hashCode() method is not overridden in the HashCodeBug class, the hashcodes of the two objects will be the same. This triggers the bug and makes the test case fail.
